name: 承認の共同作業者フッター
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Create ONE Japanese Lighthouse approval collaborators footer LH09-0040. Original images1–2 control original icon silhouettes/enclosures, photo appearance, optical weight, proportions, alignment and spacing. Image3 gives Japanese words only; do NOT copy its mint avatars or club-like bell substitute.
Wide shallow666x50 logical pixel white footer, all pure #FFFFFF canvas/ordinary surfaces, no gray/mint panel. A single vertically centered row.
At x60: label「共同作業者」Meiryo Regular12/16 muted gray. Then original compact avatar group: ORIGINAL dark photo avatar appearance in22px circle; second22px WHITE initial avatar with fine neutral outline and slate Japanese initial「佐」(no pink or mint fill); third original UNASSIGNED/add-person glyph, fine person head/shoulders inside a DASHED circular enclosure. Then original small standalone thin PLUS. Keep original tight spacing and relative sizes; no overlaps or extra names.
At right: ORIGINAL small solid gray BELL with curved dome, tiny clapper and source silhouette, then exact action「承認から退出」in Meiryo Regular14/24 neutral slate. Keep original right alignment/inset, no button box, no added dropdown. Bell must look like a bell, not club/heart/shield or outline person. All neutral support icons #526173, source-like thin strokes except original filled bell.
No bold, zero tracking, no other text or controls. No headings, app shell, watermark, annotation, comparison board, perspective or decorative colors. Tight flat crisp UI screenshot.
reviewNotes: 共同作業者／承認から退出の日本語、写真＋白い佐アバター＋破線人物＋プラス、原本の塗りベルを目視。モックのミント面とクラブ代替を避け白面へ適応。外側余白、写真バイトや厳密フォント・ベクター一致、通知退出の実動作は未証明。静的画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
